title: bzip2 decompress
summary: Decompress bzip2 streams (recorded at every level from 1 to 9, over text and binary data, two of them several blocks long) and return the original bytes.
notes: One operation decompresses one in-memory bzip2 stream and returns the decompressed bytes, compared exactly with the original. The streams were recorded once by the bzip2 1.0.8 command, so every entry decodes the same bytes; nothing is compressed in the timed call.
